findings.claim: Rolled-cylinder protocol record validates and refuses malformed variants
Measured chords and surface distances on the physical tube match the predicted gaps
The physical tube radius and roundness lie within the declared +/- 0.1 mm
The unrolled-film gauge achieves the declared 0.05 mm on marker-to-marker surface distances

hypothesis: A rolled cylinder has zero Gaussian curvature, so its Jacobi transfer equals the plate's, while its extrinsic curvature makes marker chords shorter than geodesic distances by d^3/(24 R^2) + O(d^5); a surface distance measured independently of the chord (an unrolled-film gauge) exposes that gap.
input_data: Declared tube R = 100 mm, length 300 mm, three rings of 12 markers
Declared instruments (camera 0.02 mm, tracker 0.015 mm, CMM 0.002 mm, film gauge 0.05 mm)
mathematical_model: Cylinder X(phi, z) = (R cos phi, R sin phi, z), R = 100 mm; development (R phi, z) is an isometry; gap(d) = d - 2 R sin(d / 2R) for circumferential pairs; resolvable arc solves gap(d) = k sqrt(2) u. Datum frame: least-squares cylinder axis A, scribe B, end face C, z along A, origin at A meets C, x towards B.
numerical_result: gap at 90 deg = 15.6583 mm (chord 141.421 vs geodesic 157.080); minimum resolvable arc: camera 23.9 mm, tracker 21.7 mm, CMM 11.1 mm; datum frame recovered to 2.9e-14.
observation_model: No observation. The protocol specifies CMM datum probing in a V-block pair, marker, film, tape start-pose and tape centreline measurements and the raw formats of their captures; the hardware slot is empty.

physical_validation_status.statement: Physical validation requires acquired hardware evidence; none was acquired for this task.

recommended_next_task: Acquire MFG-CYLINDER-01 and bind its exports to T138 (ciw lab run T138 --capture photogrammetry=<targets.csv> --capture film=<film.csv>), then retain the run with ciw lab hardware retain; T138's comparison of the captured gaps and chords is computational, and a physical label needs a metrology instrument probe or a signed-capture trust anchor (deferred research question). Open: model the seam weld and out-of-roundness, which the cylinder prediction omits.

title: Design a rolled-cylinder control experiment.
uncertainty: Closed forms; RK4 closure at rounding level. The radius tolerance term is budgeted in T140; the film and camera terms give U_m = 0.1149 mm for a measured gap.
unresolved_assumptions: Seam weld and out-of-roundness are not modelled; a real tube is not a perfect cylinder. The protocol puts the seam at the bottom between the vees and stops the run when a ring's roundness exceeds 0.108 mm (declared form tolerance plus 2 U of the CMM).
Marker centre offsets (target thickness) are not modelled.
The film is assumed to lie on the pair's geodesic when laid without steering, like the tapes.
